correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact n=2 model on the invariant unit simplex. The single positive endemic root follows from the quadratic with negative constant term for all 0<gamma<1. The exact 3D Jacobian has characteristic coefficients A,B,C>0. Substituting the strictly monotone gamma=G(x) gives AB-C=Q(x)/(500000(200x+1)). Two exact rational sign changes and Descartes bound prove Q has exactly two simple positive roots. Cubic Routh gives the precise stable windows and exactly two unstable eigenvalues between them; at each root the spectrum factors as (lambda+A)(lambda^2+B). The simple roots and strict G monotonicity prove transversal opposite crossings. The standalone checker was executed successfully from its current package path, checking symbolic identities, exact signs and sample spectral eigenvalues.

originality.rationale: The original paper states the numerical n=2 case at gamma=0.7 but explicitly reserves full analysis of the multi-class model for later work. Neither its published full version nor the public author preprint derives the exact recovery-rate stability window or quartic; targeted source/alias/parameter and broader precedent searches disclosed no stronger claim that logically implies these two exact thresholds. The existence of oscillations and general immune-stage stability switches is prior art and not claimed as new.
residual_risks: An equivalent all-gamma spectral partition could exist under different terminology or in unindexed older literature.
The full text of Hethcote–Stech–van den Driessche (1981) was unavailable; its broad delay-oscillation theorem is not assumed to establish noncoverage.
The full Barbarossa–Polner–Röst (2016) study was not exhaustively compared, though its abstract describes a different delay/boosting system.
The model uses recovered-class susceptibility beta_1=1, beta_2=0, a stylized parameter choice exactly taken from the source example.
Transverse imaginary-axis crossings alone do not prove existence or criticality of nonlinear Hopf periodic orbits.

value.rationale: The primary paper highlights persistent outbreaks at exactly these source parameters but leaves the multi-class system unanalyzed. The exact and exhaustive gamma thresholds quantify the onset and surprising recovery of local endemic stability in the printed biological example, distinguish two unstable dimensions from finite numerical oscillations, and identify recovery-rate ranges suitable for studying recurrent infection. This is a natural complete local stability classification of a source-motivated model slice, not an arbitrary table update or generic Hopf deduction.
